As Apple Computer (AAPL) Share Value Declined, Beach Investment Management Boosted Its Holding; Bp Plc (BP) Shareholder Arga Investment Management LP Has Lowered Its Stake as Share Value Declined
May 16, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers
Arga Investment Management Lp decreased its stake in Bp Plc (BP) by 1.24% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Arga Investment Management Lp sold 32,833 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.20% with the market. The institutional investor held 2.61 million shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $109.61M, down from 2.64 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Arga Investment Management Lp who had been investing in Bp Plc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $155.53 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.15% or $0.07 $46.72. About 4.00 million shares traded. BP p.l.c. (NYSE:BP) has risen 18.43% uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.88% the S&P500.
Beach Investment Management Llc increased its stake in Apple Computer (AAPL) by 30.21% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Beach Investment Management Llc bought 2,480 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 10,690 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.81M, up from 8,210 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Beach Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Computer for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $924.69B market cap company. The stock increased 0.91% or $1.69 $188.13. About 13.48M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.

The firm earned “Buy” rating on Tuesday, December 15 by Credit Agricole. The company was maintained on Friday, November 27 by Argus Research.
Arga Investment Management Lp, which manages about $2.25B and $898.38M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in United Technologies Corp (NYSE:UTX) by 2,600 shares to 21,700 shares, valued at $2.77 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Sasol Ltd (NYSE:SSL) by 150,200 shares in the quarter, for a total of 249,200 shares, and has risen its stake in Baidu Inc (NASDAQ:BIDU).
Analysts await BP p.l.c. (NYSE:BP) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $0.85 EPS, up 304.76% or $0.64 from last year’s $0.21 per share. BP’s profit will be $2.83B for 13.74 P/E if the $0.85 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.78 actual EPS reported by BP p.l.c. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 8.97% EPS growth.
